original_g2: Reuse matched original G2 rows. Never change original model selection, freeze, claims, report, package, deployment or prior experiment artifacts.

learning_curves.validation: Original shared 1836-response/589-pair strict-G2 intersection; recompute eligibility for each size and both seeds, with existing 100-response/30-pair fallback rule.
learning_curves.fit: At each subset refit demographic category support/reference and C/Y preprocessing on unique fitting photos; retune registered seven ridge penalties and interaction multipliers 1/10/100. Compare exact no-interaction fallback; log every candidate and failure.
learning_curves.scope: Conditional development learning curve after prior test exposure, not a new independent test or information-limit estimate.

penalty_paths: Reproduce every original demographic development candidate with zero-start and record training loss, validation loss, coefficient norm and numerical acceptance. Reconstructed losses must match logged original attempt within 1e-6.

temperature.selection: Per model choose minimum original common validation loss, tolerance 1e-6; if tied prefer temperature closest to 1, then smaller temperature. Freeze choices before accessing saved test outcomes; do not promote.
temperature.evaluation: Paired test loss differences from already-saved demographic logits/outcomes; 5000 shared pair draws, 95% pointwise unadjusted intervals.

transfer.G3: Refit and tune each demographic procedure on existing G3 core fitting and validation only, with fit-only demographics/C/Y preprocessing and known-cat identity design. Freeze before reading existing G3 test prediction outcomes; bootstrap by held-out photo.
transfer.G4: Refit and tune on existing G4 core fitting and validation only; for each unseen cat set both its pooled cat score and every demographic-specific cat-score deviation to zero. Freeze before reading existing G4 test prediction outcomes; bootstrap by held-out cat.
transfer.fallback: Demographic side-only branch plus separately tuned score-only side-adjusted fallback; never select a test winner or alter deployment.
transfer.prior_exposure: Original G2, G3, G4 outcomes have already been exposed. Prior G3/G4 comparison models were trained on different partitions. Tests are retrospective, not independent confirmation.

abstention: Reuse frozen demographic test predictions and exact prior Stage 10 confidence thresholds 0.5 to 1 step 0.025; +1 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 abstain; denominator all original test responses; shared 5000 pair-bootstrap draws; no cutoff chosen.
interpretation: Displayed A is not established to be screen-left.
Demographics-only cannot rank cats or photos.
Demographic missing columns are redundant and individual missing-field effects are not separately identifiable.
No confidence- or utility-based deployment decision.
